items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I used to (inaudible) tell Johnny Hodges, "Hey, sign him up, sign him up, we'll get him in the band."

ctx.x: Well, you know, the famous Tab Smith, he was the next thing to Johnny Hodges. He was great. He was great -- Tab. Everybody loved Tab Smith.
And this is 'Midnight Blue', Lost In My Dreams -- you remember some of these?
